guard: a supervised seat outlives its manager's crash: the successor restarts it under the same lifecycle as one restart of its policy, serves it the turn the dead manager accepted, and retires it once the budget is spent
why: Live: real broker, real Manager in a child process SIGKILLed mid-turn, real pty runtime and a stub seat that joins presence.
Manager source is imported directly by the host through tsx, so no mutation needs a build.

mutations.name: the successor retires a supervised seat instead of restarting it
mutations.expectRed: the successor restarts the supervised seat as one restart of its policy
mutations.cell: the successor restarts the supervised seat as one restart of its policy

mutations.name: a supervised spawn writes no record
mutations.expectRed: the first manager starts a supervised seat and records it with no restart counted
mutations.cell: the first manager starts a supervised seat and records it with no restart counted

mutations.name: the crash restart drops the policy it was granted under
mutations.find: crashes: supervised.crashes, recovering: false, armed: false, policy: supervised.policy } }
mutations.replace: crashes: supervised.crashes, recovering: false, armed: false } }
mutations.expectRed: the record counts the manager crash against the policy
mutations.cell: the record counts the manager crash against the policy
